description: [Data utilities] Get current weather and a 7-day forecast for any city or coordinate before travel, logistics, events or field work. Use when a plan depends on the weather in the coming days. Price: $0.006 per call (USDC on Base, x402). Returns the x402 payment requirements unless payment_signature is given. Sample: /samples/met-weather

country.description: Optional ISO2 country to disambiguate the city

payment_signature.description: Optional x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value, relayed unchanged to the endpoint. Omit to receive the payment requirements.

name: weather_forecast
title: Global Weather Now and 7-Day Forecast (MET Norway) ($0.006)
